summary: First lookout placed 1930 or 1931 (sources differ); current 30-foot tower built 1958; staffed to at least 1975; abandoned, on private land with no public access.

facts.design: 30-foot open timber tower with an R-6 flat-top cab (built 1958); the earlier 1931 structure was a 30-foot pole live-in tower
facts.status_note: Standing but abandoned for many years, on private property.

access.note: On private property with no public access, per the register and the firelookout.com listing; the 2026 standing list also marks it not accessible to the public.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register places the first lookout in 1930 under the Klamath National Forest; the firelookout.com page and the Oregon Lookouts page date the development to 1931, the second crediting the Crater National Forest. The story gives both dates and does not choose between them. The 1958 date for the current tower is consistent across sources.

notes_for_editor: The brief's 1931 build date is one of two conflicting first-lookout dates; the register's 1930 date is recorded as an event. The brief's access 'unknown' is now 'private'. Height 9.1 m matches the 30-foot tower in the sources. The Oregon Lookouts site has other Table Mountain pages (table-mountain1, table-mountain3) for different mountains in other counties; they were not used. No fires are recorded in the pages read.
